name: Materuni waterfall and coffee village
why: Through banana and coffee gardens of a Chagga village on the slopes of Kilimanjaro to a 80 m waterfall in a green gorge.
book: Village fee at Materuni; local guides offer a coffee-making visit. Dala-dala or taxi from Moshi (40 min).

points.name: Materuni village
points.note: A Chagga village of coffee and banana plots.

points.name: Materuni Waterfalls
points.note: A tall waterfall into a fern-lined gorge.
